title: TLS handshake errors logged at debug, not warn
description: In main.rs the accept loop logs TLS handshake failures at tracing::debug! (line 123-124). In production, RUST_LOG defaults exclude debug. When a self-signed cert expires, clients get connection failures and the daemon emits nothing at info/warn/error level. The operator sees zero signal. Certificate expiry is a predictable failure mode for a daemon that auto-generates self-signed certs. Fix: promote TLS handshake failures to tracing::warn! so they appear in default production logs.
